feed.title: Free small-business calculators — tools on marisstella.dev
feed.subtitle: The 979 free, browser-only tools served directly from marisstella.dev — the newest 20 of them listed here, newest first. No account, no upload: every number stays on your own device. The full catalogue is larger and lives at tools.marisstella.dev.
feed.rights: Tools are MIT-licensed. They are estimates and records to act on, not professional advice.

entry.title: App Review Insights — Free App Store and Google Play Review Analyzer
entry.summary: Free app review analyzer: drop in your Google Play or App Store review CSV and see which release dropped your rating, which complaints cost the most stars, and which unhappy reviews you have not answered. Runs in your browser, nothing is uploaded.

entry.title: Postgres Index Auditor — Find Unused, Duplicate and Redundant Indexes
entry.summary: Free Postgres index auditor: run one read-only query, paste the result, and see unused, duplicate, redundant and invalid indexes, the disk they waste and DROP INDEX statements to review. Runs in your browser, never touches your database.

entry.title: Veterinary Dental Estimate Calculator — Cost and Profit by Grade 1-4
entry.summary: Free calculator for veterinary clinics: itemised dental estimate and clinic profit for each grade of dental disease, profit per anesthesia hour, the price that hits your margin and what a flat dental quote loses. Runs in your browser.

entry.title: Wholesale vs Retail Pricing Calculator for Makers — Direct, Wholesale, Consignment
entry.summary: Free calculator for makers and small brands: what you keep per unit and per order selling direct, wholesale or on consignment, after fees, shipping, your time and payment terms. Runs in your browser.
